title: Bita Business application
description: Bita is a comprehensive business management platform built to help Ethiopian businesses digitize their operations. It combines Point of Sale, Inventory Management, Sales, CRM, Financial Management, and Business Analytics into a single integrated system
problem: Small and medium-sized businesses in Ethiopia often rely on paper records, spreadsheets, or disconnected software to manage daily operations. As businesses grow, they struggle with inventory inaccuracies, inefficient sales processes, inconsistent financial records, and limited visibility into business performance. Existing enterprise solutions are frequently too expensive, overly complex, or not designed for the Ethiopian market.
problemPoints: Manual inventory tracking leading to stock discrepancies.
Difficulty monitoring sales across multiple branches.
Lack of centralized customer and supplier management.
Poor visibility into business performance and profitability.
Human errors caused by paper-based processes.
Limited support for Ethiopian business workflows.
Inefficient employee and user permission management.
Slow checkout process in retail environments.
No reliable audit trail for business activities.
solution: Gumisofts designed and developed Bita as an end-to-end business management solution that addresses the operational challenges faced by growing businesses. By consolidating multiple business functions into one unified platform, Bita enables organizations to automate routine processes, improve operational accuracy, and gain complete visibility across their operations.
solutionPoints: Real-time inventory management with automatic stock updates.
Integrated CRM for customers, suppliers, and contacts.
Interactive dashboards with real-time analytics and KPIs.
Sales, payment, credit, and reconciliation management.
Unified platform combining POS, inventory, finance, and CRM.
Fast Point-of-Sale system optimized for retail environments.

title: Savana Online Marketplace
description: Savana Marketplace is a B2B e-commerce marketplace platform based on East Africa and Ethiopia that connects buyer and seller and ensures buyer-seller transactions, trust, and reliability.
problem:
Ethiopia's B2B Trade Is Still Highly Fragmented
Despite rapid digital adoption, a large portion of business procurement in Ethiopia still relies on traditional methods such as:
- Phone calls
- Telegram groups
- Facebook posts
- Word-of-mouth referrals
- Physical market visits
- Personal business networks
This creates several challenges for buyers and suppliers alike.
problemPoints: Limited Trust Between Buyers and Suppliers
solution: Savana introduces a unified B2B marketplace that digitizes procurement from discovery to order placement.

title: Entrance Tricks Grade 9 - 12
description: Are you preparing for university entrance exams or looking to ace your school tests? Entrance Tricks is designed to help you study smarter, not harder. We break down complex subjects into easy-to-remember "tricks" and provide structured paths to academic success.
problem:
Ethiopian students face significant barriers in preparing for national entrance examinations.
Every year, hundreds of thousands of Grade 9–12 students compete for limited university placements.
problemPoints: Limited Access to Quality Learning Materials
solution: Entrance Tricks grade 9 - 12  brings everything students need into one mobile application.

title: TemariCo – National Exam Prep
description: We developed TemariCo, a collaborative platform designed to help high school students across Ethiopia succeed in their entrance exams.
problem:
Many Ethiopian high school students, especially those in rural areas, have limited access to quality textbooks, exam preparation materials, video lessons, and experienced teachers. Educational resources are often outdated or difficult to obtain.
University entrance exams are highly competitive, yet many students prepare without a clear study plan or sufficient practice tests. Students often study alone and have limited opportunities to discuss difficult topics, ask questions, or learn from peers.
problemPoints: Limited Access to High-Quality Learning Resources
Lack of Structured Entrance Exam Preparation
solution: TemariCo is a collaborative digital learning platform that empowers Ethiopian high school students with curriculum-aligned study materials, interactive learning, peer collaboration, mock examinations, personalized progress tracking, and mentorship—helping every student prepare confidently and perform better in university entrance exams.
